6-s88.condition: Unit 3, Step 6, упр. 6, с. 88. A) Скажи, что обычно делают Марк, его друзья и родные в указанное время. B) Представь, что сейчас это время, и скажи, что они делают (без usually / always / often).
steps: A) Mark always gets up at 7. Mark and Jack often go to school together at 8. At 10 Mark and his friends read, speak and write in their English lessons. Mark usually comes home at 2…

B) It's 7 o'clock. Mark is getting up. It's 8 o'clock. Mark and Jack are going to school together. It's 10 o'clock. Mark and his friends are reading, speaking and writing. It's 2 o'clock. Mark is coming home.
6-s88.answer: A) Present Simple с наречиями частотности: gets up, go, read/speak/write, comes home. B) Present Continuous: is getting up, are going, are reading, is coming home.

Свой рассказ: My name is … I live in … Street. My flat is … We have … My room is …
7-s89.answer: Описание своей квартиры по плану: город, улица, какая квартира, какие комнаты, своя комната.

steps: РТ 1 (аудио): слева — cinema, flower shop, bank, sweet shop, swimming pool; справа — school, food shop, garage, park.

РТ 3: them, him, her, us, me, it.
РТ 4: прописываем слова.
РТ 5: проходим ворота по порядку от A до Q.
8-s90.answer: РТ 1: здания на улице. РТ 2: вопросы How many…? с ответами. РТ 3: them, him, her, us, me, it. РТ 5: A → Q.

B) Обычно (Present Simple): They always come to their garden in spring and summer. Chase and Smokey like to play in the garden. They often play it in the afternoon. Сейчас (Present Continuous): Mr Barker is reading, John and Sally are playing ping-pong…

There are — о нескольких: There are some flowers on the cupboard. There are three chairs at the table…

4-s101.condition: Unit 4, Step 2, упр. 4, с. 101. A, B, C) Скажи, что находится в разных местах, используя there is / there are / there is some.
steps: A) There is an egg in the eggcup. There is an orange on the table. There is a bee on the flower. There is an armchair by the window. There is a sofa in the living room. There is a blackboard on the wall.

B) There are some benches in the garden. There are some plants on the windowsill. There are some big classrooms on this floor. There are some maps on the walls. There are some new cups in the cupboard. There are some teddy bears in the toy shop.

C) There is some ice on the lake. There is some coffee in the cup. There is some food on the shelf. There is some ice cream on the apple pie. There is some milk on the table. There is some birthday cake on the dish.
4-s101.answer: A) There is a/an + ед. число. B) There are some + мн. число. C) There is some + неисчисляемое (ice, coffee, food, milk, cake).
